title: FAQ Section
description: Reusable, prop-driven FAQ accordion section for marketing pages. Composes a header (eyebrow / title / subtitle) with a shadcn Accordion of question/answer items. Three layouts: single column, two-column split (md+), and grouped-by-category with labelled sub-sections. Optional footer CTA ("Still have questions?") with link. Server-component shell that mounts the shadcn Accordion client primitive as a leaf island.
